task: human action from video frames (6 actions)

dataset.name: KTH human actions (Schuldt, Laptev & Caputo, ICPR 2004)
dataset.license: KTH: 'publicly available for non-commercial use'; cite the ICPR'04 paper
dataset.sample: held-out: ICPR'04 test persons 02 03 05 06 07 08 09 10 22 x 6 actions = 54 clips, scenario rotated d1-d4; validation: persons 11, 12 x 6 = 12 clips; first subsequence of each file, 16 frames evenly spaced, native 160x120 greyscale

checker: exact match to one of 6 labels after normalising (see scripts/levers_video.py grade)

prompts.plain: You will see {what} from one short video clip of a single person, in time order, evenly spaced over about 2-4 seconds. Classify the person's action as exactly one of: walking, jogging, running, boxing, handwaving, handclapping. Answer with that one word only.
prompts.defs: You will see {what} from one short video clip of a single person, in time order, evenly spaced over about 2-4 seconds. Classify the person's action as exactly one of: walking, jogging, running, boxing, handwaving, handclapping. Answer with that one word only. Definitions: walking = moving across the scene at a slow pace; jogging = moving across at a medium pace with a light bounce; running = moving across fast with long strides and the body leaning forward; boxing = standing and punching forward with fists; handwaving = standing and waving both arms up over the head; handclapping = standing and clapping the hands in front of the chest. Compare the frames: how far the person moves between frames tells the pace.

rows.label: boxing
rows.answer: The person is standing in place and extending an arm forward, holding an object, with no significant movement

rows.label: handwaving
rows.answer: The person is standing with arms outstretched and does not move across the scene between the two frames

rows.label: boxing
rows.answer:
The person is standing and punching forward with their fists. This matches the definition of boxing.
